description: D.G. Khan Cement Company Limited is a public limited company incorporated in Pakistan and listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. It is primarily engaged in the production and sale of clinker, Ordinary Portland Cement and Sulphate Resistant Cement. The company operates four cement plants on dry-process technology — two at Dera Ghazi Khan, one at Khairpur in Chakwal district and one at Hub in Lasbela district, Balochistan — giving it a production capacity of 22,400 tons per day.
